== Summary ==
Slip “This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don’t Alter It Any Further” cut unchanged from page 2 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 26 December 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (69, 791, 581, 1146)). Original [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further (V)|Virtual Set 26 publication]]. Not a recreation. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260428005738/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Internet Archive].
